input.text: Staff escalate every complaint that alleges unfair treatment to the regional manager the same day.
sources: Complaints that allege unfair treatment are escalated to the regional manager the same day.

input.text: Staff resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.
sources: Resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.

input.text: Staff credit the customer provisionally no later than 10 business days after the dispute form is complete.
sources: Credit the customer provisionally no later than 10 business days after the dispute form is complete.

input.text: A card services specialist reviews every dispute over $500 before credit is issued.
sources: Disputes over $500 are reviewed by a card services specialist before credit is issued.

input.text: Customers have 60 days from the statement date to dispute a debit card transaction. The window is longer when the customer was traveling or hospitalized.
sources: Customers have 60 days from the statement date to dispute a debit card transaction, or longer when the customer was traveling or hospitalized.
